BEFORE YOU PARK IT.

How do model scales work?

A 1:24 model is 24 times smaller than the real car. A 1:18 model of the same vehicle is larger, while a 1:43 model takes up less shelf space. Exact dimensions vary by vehicle.

Are these real products I can order?

This is the DRMZ storefront preview. Products and prices are sample catalogue content. Orders, stock availability, delivery and payment options will be confirmed when the store launches.

Will my cart be saved?

Yes. Your selection is saved in this browser on this device. You can change quantities, remove models or download your selection at any time.

Where can I find RC models?

The RC collection is being prepared. Open the RC section for its current status, or explore the diecast collections in the meantime.
